hard_rules: Do not create new primary categories after inspecting Open3DSG metric failures without bumping schema_version.
Use plausible_unlabeled only with visual/audit evidence; do not use it to hide false positives.
Rows with adapter_or_identity_error are excluded until fixed and cannot support method claims.
Rows outside support_contact/proximity/relative_vertical are excluded from H001 family claims.
Do not count preprocessing_or_filtering_limitation as an Open3DSG semantic failure.
Do not use Qwen-VL outputs to assign Open3DSG failure categories.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: exact GT match and verification_status in satisfied/uncertain with no contradiction.
primary_categories.definition: Prediction exactly matches a GT relation and geometry is satisfied or non-contradictory.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: no exact/family GT match and verification_status is satisfied, uncertain, unsupported, or missing_geometry.
primary_categories.definition: Prediction is not supported by GT for the directed pair and geometry does not provide an independent contradiction.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: verification_status=violated regardless of GT match; audit may later refine plausible-unlabeled cases.
primary_categories.definition: Prediction is semantically plausible or high-ranked but violates frozen H001 geometry checks.
Prediction is unsupported by GT and also geometrically contradicted.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: no GT match, verification_status=satisfied/uncertain, and audit marks relation plausible.
primary_categories.definition: Prediction lacks a GT label but geometry and visual/audit evidence suggest the relation may be valid.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: family GT match without exact predicate match, e.g. higher/lower or support/contact variants.
primary_categories.definition: Prediction chooses a neighboring predicate in the same family where label granularity is ambiguous.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: edge ids do not align with 3DSSG context or visual evidence points to a different object pair.
primary_categories.definition: Prediction targets the wrong directed object pair or object identity mapping is inconsistent.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: geometry_checkable=true but verification_status=uncertain due to missing local support/point evidence.
primary_categories.definition: Frozen geometry verifier cannot decide because required geometry evidence is missing or too weak.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: subgraph/scan belongs to filtered or skipped preprocess/view coverage records.
primary_categories.definition: Row is affected by known Open3DSG preprocessing/view/filter limitations rather than model semantics.
Predicate family is outside H001 geometry-checkable families.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: GT exact match exists for the pair/predicate but semantic_rank_in_subgraph is outside top-k.
primary_categories.definition: Correct relation exists but is ranked below the evaluated top-k cutoff.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: large semantic-vs-geometry rank disagreement not explained by GT noise or unsupported family.
primary_categories.definition: Semantic score is poorly ordered relative to geometry/GT evidence without an identity or verifier error.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: adapter validation or identity-preservation checks fail.
primary_categories.definition: Failure comes from raw dump conversion, id mapping, duplicate rows, or schema violation.

primary_categories.assignment_hint: use only as a temporary label before sampled audit or explicit exclusion.
primary_categories.definition: Available fields are insufficient to assign a stable category.
